item.title: Akasaka Palace Night Opening
item.description:
For one weekend in November, Akasaka Palace stays open after dark. The night opening is on Saturday, November 21 and Sunday, November 22, 2026.

The post appeared first on Tokyo Cheapo.

item.title: Much Ado About Nothing by Sheepdog Theatre
item.description: Tokyo’s English-language troupe is staging Shakespeare’s sharpest comedy in Nakano.
